name: Brave Order[✨ New gameplay] UPDATE 3
desc:
Welcome to Brave Order, a fun and thrilling monster-bashing game where you rescue your imprisoned companions from the clutches of demons and bring them back to your team!

🔥 Move and shoot, while dodging bullets
⚔️ Defeat enemies to obtain coins and better gears
👊 Use coins to hatch powerful pets
💪 Choose from hundreds of skill combos
👑 Team up with your friends to advance faster
❤️ Ride your mount and carry your companions
🏆 Climb various leaderboards to see who's the real boss!


Please give us a thumbs-up 👍 and favorite ⭐ if you enjoy the game.
